styles.name: golden-spiral
styles.description: The true golden spiral: quarter-circle arcs through the 13-8-5-3-2-1-1 Fibonacci squares, traced inward with progress as the rectangle rides a rail and a bead runs the curve

styles.name: golden-rectangle
styles.description: Recursive φ-rectangle subdivision into a square + smaller φ-rectangle — the whirling-rectangles diagram, with each subdivision revealed as progress rises

styles.name: fibonacci-squares
styles.description: Fibonacci squares 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 growing outward in the whirling layout, the view zooming out to frame each new square as it is inked

styles.name: pentagram
styles.description: Upright pentagram {5/2} in its pentagon (the next star nests in the inner pentagon, scaled 1/φ², once there is room), riding a rail with progress while a glint runs the star's single stroke

styles.name: pentagon-nest
styles.description: Concentric pentagons each scaled 1/φ² smaller, counter-rotating with time — a hypnotic tunnel of five-fold symmetry

styles.name: golden-gnomon
styles.description: Golden triangle and gnomon: a frieze of 36-72-72 golden triangles, each cut into a 36-36-108 gnomon and a smaller golden triangle, which is cut again and again so the pieces whirl inward in a spiral; turns added with progress

styles.name: phi-phyllotaxis-pent
styles.description: Five-fold phyllotaxis: seeds placed at the golden angle but grouped into five symmetric spiral arms, creating pentagonal lattice symmetry with φ spacing

styles.name: nautilus
styles.description: φ-logarithmic nautilus shell: three whorls, each ~2× the last, traced from the outer lip inward with progress, chamber walls every 45° behind the open body chamber

styles.name: golden-angle-rays
styles.description: 21 rays at successive 137.5° golden-angle increments around a hub, each growing longer — the irrational spacing that prevents clustering and produces optimal coverage of the disk

styles.name: dodecagram
styles.description: Dodecagram {12/5}: a frieze of twelve-pointed stars (every 5th vertex of a 12-gon joined, drawn as the star's silhouette); each star is traced point by point along the strip with progress and turns slowly, alternate stars counter-rotating

styles.name: kepler-triangle
styles.description: Kepler triangle: the right triangle with sides 1:√φ:φ and the squares on its sides (areas 1, φ, φ² — Pythagoras becomes φ² = φ + 1), built panel by panel along the strip
